title: models
description: Extra model names a client may send, each pinned to a model file on a registered backend. A role with a pinned model, without a role's access policy (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C10). The key is the model name the client sends.

backend.description: A service id of the registry.

path.description: The model file on the backend's host.

model_metadata.description: What /v1/models reports for this model name; each field here wins over the derived value (gateway/model_metadata.py, docs/api/MODEL_METADATA.md). Any subset of the five fields.
